reply.answer_text: In a discounted gift trust (DGT) at year 3, only the discounted gift is inside the estate. The retained payments have been carved out and are no longer part of it. The discounted amount is the original investment minus the actuarial discount value of the settlor's retained payments — the portion that left the estate immediately when the trust was set up.
